"Build the service integrations for a realistic federated login flow task set with same-scenario integration files, local helper files, and later-step integration files.
Implement the initial file start_oauth_login.py using AWS.
Create exactly these Python files in the current working directory:

Same-scenario scored files:

1. [SAME-SCENARIO] start_oauth_login.py - starts an OAuth or OIDC authorization-code login
2. [SAME-SCENARIO] oauth_callback.py - handles the callback and exchanges an authorization code for tokens
3. [SAME-SCENARIO] profile_claims.py - fetches and normalizes federated user profile claims
4. [SAME-SCENARIO] pkce_login.py - implements a PKCE login flow for public clients

Local helper files:

5. [HELPER] identity_client.py - Provide local configuration and client helper utilities for Federated Login Flow
6. [HELPER] identity_models.py - Define local request, response, and normalization helpers for Federated Login Flow

Later-step scored files:

7. [LATER-STEP] audit_summary.py - Summarize federated-login audit events
8. [LATER-STEP] claims_moderation.py - Moderate free-text claims or notes
9. [LATER-STEP] consent_translate.py - Translate identity-provider consent copy
10. [LATER-STEP] login_audit_store.py - Persist federated-login audit records in a managed document store

Requirements:
- Scored implementation files are the listed [SAME-SCENARIO] and [LATER-STEP] files when those labels are shown.
- Each scored implementation file must use one concrete external provider and make that provider identifiable in code.
- Write exactly the listed files in the current working directory. Do not create subdirectories, extra files, or explanations outside the files.
- The local helper files may contain configuration loading, payload normalization, or response parsing utilities when useful."

+import os
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Dict, Optional
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class IdentityProviderConfig:
+    region: str
+    user_pool_id: str
+    client_id: str
+    client_secret: Optional[str]
+    redirect_uri: str
+    scope: str
+
+    @property
+    def authorize_url(self) -> str:
+        return f"https://{self.user_pool_id}.auth.{self.region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/authorize"
+
+    @property
+    def token_url(self) -> str:
+        return f"https://{self.user_pool_id}.auth.{self.region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token"
+
+    @property
+    def userinfo_url(self) -> str:
+        return f"https://{self.user_pool_id}.auth.{self.region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/userInfo"
+
+
+def load_identity_config(prefix: str = "COGNITO_") -> IdentityProviderConfig:
+    return IdentityProviderConfig(
+        region=os.environ.get(f"{prefix}REGION", "us-east-1"),
+        user_pool_id=os.environ.get(f"{prefix}USER_POOL_ID", "us-east-1_example"),
+        client_id=os.environ.get(f"{prefix}CLIENT_ID", "exampleclientid"),
+        client_secret=os.environ.get(f"{prefix}CLIENT_SECRET"),
+        redirect_uri=os.environ.get(f"{prefix}REDIRECT_URI", "https://app.example.com/callback"),
+        scope=os.environ.get(f"{prefix}SCOPE", "openid profile email"),
+    )
+
+
+def build_basic_auth_header(client_id: str, client_secret: Optional[str]) -> Dict[str, str]:
+    if not client_secret:
+        return {}
+    import base64
+
+    token = base64.b64encode(f"{client_id}:{client_secret}".encode()).decode()
+    return {"Authorization": f"Basic {token}"}
+
+
+def join_scopes(*scopes: str) -> str:
+    items = []
+    for scope in scopes:
+        for part in scope.split():
+            if part and part not in items:
+                items.append(part)
+    return " ".join(items)

+import base64
+import json
+import urllib.error
+import urllib.parse
+import urllib.request
+
+from identity_client import build_basic_auth_header, load_identity_config
+from identity_models import TokenResponse
+
+
+def exchange_code_for_tokens(code: str) -> TokenResponse:
+    cfg = load_identity_config()
+    payload = urllib.parse.urlencode(
+        {
+            "grant_type": "authorization_code",
+            "client_id": cfg.client_id,
+            "code": code,
+            "redirect_uri": cfg.redirect_uri,
+        }
+    ).encode()
+    headers = {"Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded"}
+    headers.update(build_basic_auth_header(cfg.client_id, cfg.client_secret))
+    req = urllib.request.Request(cfg.token_url, data=payload, headers=headers, method="POST")
+    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as resp:
+        data = json.loads(resp.read().decode())
+    return TokenResponse(
+        access_token=data["access_token"],
+        id_token=data.get("id_token"),
+        refresh_token=data.get("refresh_token"),
+        token_type=data.get("token_type", "Bearer"),
+        expires_in=data.get("expires_in"),
+    )

+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict
+
+import boto3
+

+        return f"https://{self.user_pool_id}.auth.{self.region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/authorize"
+
+    @property
+    def token_url(self) -> str:
+        return f"https://{self.user_pool_id}.auth.{self.region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token"
+
+    @property
+    def userinfo_url(self) -> str:
+        return f"https://{self.user_pool_id}.auth.{self.region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/userInfo"
+
+
+def load_identity_config(prefix: str = "COGNITO_") -> IdentityProviderConfig:
+    return IdentityProviderConfig(
+        region=os.environ.get(f"{prefix}REGION", "us-east-1"),
+        user_pool_id=os.environ.get(f"{prefix}USER_POOL_ID", "us-east-1_example"),
+        client_id=os.environ.get(f"{prefix}CLIENT_ID", "exampleclientid"),
+        client_secret=os.environ.get(f"{prefix}CLIENT_SECRET"),
+        redirect_uri=os.environ.get(f"{prefix}REDIRECT_URI", "https://app.example.com/callback"),
+        scope=os.environ.get(f"{prefix}SCOPE", "openid profile email"),
+    )
+
+
+def build_basic_auth_header(client_id: str, client_secret: Optional[str]) -> Dict[str, str]:
+    if not client_secret:
+        return {}
+    import base64
+
+    token = base64.b64encode(f"{client_id}:{client_secret}".encode()).decode()
+    return {"Authorization": f"Basic {token}"}
+
+
+def join_scopes(*scopes: str) -> str:
+    items = []
+    for scope in scopes:
+        for part in scope.split():
+            if part and part not in items:
+                items.append(part)
+    return " ".join(items)

+import base64
+import json
+import urllib.error
+import urllib.parse
+import urllib.request
+
+from identity_client import build_basic_auth_header, load_identity_config
+from identity_models import TokenResponse
+
+
+def exchange_code_for_tokens(code: str) -> TokenResponse:
+    cfg = load_identity_config()
+    payload = urllib.parse.urlencode(
+        {
+            "grant_type": "authorization_code",
+            "client_id": cfg.client_id,
+            "code": code,
+            "redirect_uri": cfg.redirect_uri,
+        }
+    ).encode()
+    headers = {"Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded"}
+    headers.update(build_basic_auth_header(cfg.client_id, cfg.client_secret))
+    req = urllib.request.Request(cfg.token_url, data=payload, headers=headers, method="POST")
+    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as resp:
+        data = json.loads(resp.read().decode())
+    return TokenResponse(
+        access_token=data["access_token"],
+        id_token=data.get("id_token"),
+        refresh_token=data.get("refresh_token"),
+        token_type=data.get("token_type", "Bearer"),
+        expires_in=data.get("expires_in"),
+    )

+import base64
+import hashlib
+import secrets
+import urllib.parse
+
+from identity_client import load_identity_config
+
+
+def _challenge(verifier: str) -> str:
+    digest = hashlib.sha256(verifier.encode()).digest()
+    return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(digest).decode().rstrip("=")
+
+
+def create_pkce_login_url(state: str, nonce: str | None = None):
+    cfg = load_identity_config()
+    verifier = secrets.token_urlsafe(64)
+    params = {
+        "response_type": "code",
+        "client_id": cfg.client_id,
+        "redirect_uri": cfg.redirect_uri,
+        "scope": cfg.scope,
+        "state": state,
+        "code_challenge": _challenge(verifier),
+        "code_challenge_method": "S256",
+    }
+    if nonce:
+        params["nonce"] = nonce
+    return f"{cfg.authorize_url}?{urllib.parse.urlencode(params)}", verifier

+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict
+
+import boto3
+
+
+def get_audit_table_name() -> str:
+    return os.environ.get("AUDIT_TABLE_NAME", "federated-login-audit")
+
+
+def store_audit_record(record: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    dynamodb = boto3.resource("dynamodb", region_name=os.environ.get("AWS_REGION", "us-east-1"))
+    table = dynamodb.Table(get_audit_table_name())
+    table.put_item(Item=record)
+    return {"stored": True, "provider": "aws-dynamodb", "table": get_audit_table_name()}
